studies.latest_known: The 2020 GEM Report remains the dedicated thematic report on inclusion in education. Subsequent GEM Reports cover different themes: 2023 (technology), 2024/5 (leadership in education). A 2026 GEM Report on 'access and equity' has been published (UNESCO, 2026), which contains updated data on inclusive education legislation and disability inclusion in mainstream schools, but is a different thematic report rather than a replacement. No revised edition of the 2020 report found.
studies.what_changed: Not applicable — source not used in draft.
